content.title: Muslims Day Brings You ‘Barakah Pass’!
content.subtitle: Have you activated your Barakah Pass yet?
content.body:
Tanvir Ahmed works as a Project Manager at a private software company. From morning till night, his days used to be consumed by coding bugs, client meetings, and intense project deadlines, leaving him with a strange sense of spiritual emptiness. Although he managed to offer his prayers, finding time for other acts of worship seemed almost impossible.

But then, one day, his routine suddenly changed. Now, during his busy workday, a small reminder from Muslims Day appears on Tanvir’s phone—“Recite Durood” or “Allahumma Salli Ala Muhammad.” He takes his eyes off the laptop screen and quietly recites Durood. In that moment, the exhaustion of long hours is replaced by a soothing sense of peace. A little while later, another reminder may appear during a break—“Astaghfirullah,” “Seek forgiveness for your sins.”

When such quiet changes in faith enter the busy lives of millions of brothers and sisters like Tanvir Ahmed, that is when all our efforts truly become worthwhile.

A Dedicated Team Behind the Scenes

To ensure that your journey of spiritual growth remains smooth and sustainable, a dedicated team of 15–20 people works day and night behind the scenes. Continuous research into new features, maintaining the technical infrastructure, and keeping the app running for millions of people around the world require a significant amount of investment. To keep this da’wah mission self-sustaining, we have made some features premium, with the contribution set at only 100 BDT per month—so that it remains within everyone’s reach.

The Light of Deen Is Open to Everyone

However, we deeply understand that everyone’s financial circumstances are not always the same. For many students and young brothers and sisters in particular, even this small amount may not always be affordable. But should a lack of financial means prevent a believer from progressing in their deeds or spiritual growth? Never. Our core goal is to help every Muslim make today better than yesterday. We cannot allow someone’s spiritual journey towards their Lord to come to a halt because of a small financial barrier. Islam is for everyone, and the forgiveness and Barakah of our Lord are open to all.

A Gift of Respect and Love: ‘Barakah Pass’

For those who are currently going through financial difficulties, Muslims Day brings a gift of love called ‘Barakah Pass’. Completely free of charge, you can enjoy all the premium benefits of the app. You can easily activate your Barakah Pass by going to the subscription page of the app.

Become a Part of a Unique Sadaqah Jariyah

For those whom Allah has blessed with financial means and comfort, we humbly invite you to increase your contribution to this noble da’wah mission while taking a premium subscription for yourself. With your support, we will be able to go even further, In Sha Allah. When another brother begins to engage in acts of worship because of your support, a significant portion of the reward for every moment of their worship can continue to be recorded in your book of deeds as Sadaqah Jariyah. So, let us hold each other’s hands on this journey towards the pleasure of our Lord and move forward on the path to Jannah. Have you activated your Barakah Pass yet?

👉 Watch this video to learn how to activate your Barakah Pass: https://youtube.com/shorts/WpALozjYcXg?feature=share
